description: This file declares parsing functions related to Git configuration values, including integer, boolean, size, and double parsing, as well as environment variable handling.

methods.name: git_parse_signed
methods.description: Parses a string value into a signed integer (`intmax_t`), with a maximum value constraint.

methods.name: git_parse_unsigned
methods.description: Parses a string value into an unsigned integer (`uintmax_t`), with a maximum value constraint.

methods.name: git_parse_ulong
methods.description: Parses a string into an `unsigned long`.

methods.name: git_parse_int64
methods.description: Parses a string into a 64-bit integer (`int64_t`).

methods.name: git_parse_maybe_bool
methods.description: Parses a string into a boolean value, returning -1 on error.

methods.name: git_env_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from an environment variable.

methods.name: git_env_ulong
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long value from an environment variable.
